channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Targeted measures to boost high-value Bumiputera firms
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The government will prioritise the development of Bumiputera entrepreneurs under the 13th Malaysia Plan (13MP) through targeted interventions, Economy Minister Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir said.

item.title: Bursa Malaysia stays higher at midday on buying activities
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Bursa Malaysia stayed higher at midday on continued buying activities in selected financial services, and consumer products and services sectors.

item.title: New York model, carved in a basement, goes on display
item.description: NEW YORK: A painstakingly detailed model of New York City will go on display this week after a US truck driver spent 21 years building it in his basement as an evening hobby.

item.title: 56 GROs among 66 foreigners rounded up in entertainment centre raid
item.description: JOHOR BARU: Johor Immigration enforcement officers detained 66 foreigners, including 56 women suspected of being guest relations officers (GRO), during a raid at an entertainment centre here last night.

item.title: JDT's Asian challenge suffers a blow in Hiroshima
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Johor Darul Ta’zim’s (JDT) hopes of securing a place in the Asian Champions League Elite (ACLE) knockout stage is hanging in the balance after suffering a 2-1 loss to Sanfrecce Hiroshima at the Hiroshima Soccer Stadium on Tuesday.

item.title: Axia driver in viral LDP cone-throwing road rage incident fined RM100
item.description: SHAH ALAM: A lorry driver who was filmed hurling a traffic cone at a car in a road rage incident on the Damansara-Puchong Expressway was fined a maximum of RM100 by the magistrate’s court today.

item.title: World Bank trims Thailand's 2026 GDP growth outlook to 1.6pct from 1.7pct
item.description: BANGKOK: Thailand's economic growth is projected to slow to 1.6 per cent this year, reflecting weaker global trade, high household debt and a slower recovery in tourism, the World Bank said on Wednesday.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Former TVB star Liu Wai Hung to open fish ball shop in KL
item.description: HONG KONG: Retired actor Liu Wai-hung, fondly known as Ah Chan, stepped away from showbiz in the 1990s to pursue business.

item.title: Anwar moves to bolster Malaysia's international influence, says expert
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim is boosting Malaysia’s international influence and restoring its global standing, an expert said, citing his frequent overseas visits.

item.title: AirAsia X unveils Kuala Lumpur-Bahrain-London route, establishing Middle Eastern hub
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia's AirAsia X announced a new international route on Wednesday linking Kuala Lumpur to Bahrain and onward to London's Gatwick airport, in the latest step in the budget airline's global expansion efforts.
